workflow_runs.name: CLA Assistant
workflow_runs.display_title: Handle orphan exec ends without clobbering active exploring cell

head_commit.message:
docs(tui): document exec-end orphan routing invariants

Document the exec-end ownership routing contract in chatwidget and
explain why orphan unified exec ends render as standalone history
entries while an unrelated exploring cell remains active.

Also document ExecCell::complete_call returning false as a routing
mismatch signal so future changes do not treat missing call IDs as a
benign no-op.
